about.title: About me
about.text: I am a FullStack Developer specialized in modern technologies such as JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, PHP, and Laravel. I have strong experience in building REST APIs, developing complete platforms, automating processes with Selenium and Pandas, and creating scalable web applications using clean architecture and clean code principles. I work with modeling and managing databases such as MongoDB, MySQL, and SQL Server, always prioritizing performance and structure. I also develop modern interfaces using React, Next.js, TailwindCSS, and Styled Components, focusing on delivering efficient products with exceptional user experiences. I have solid experience in building automated workflows, CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, containerization with Docker, and DevOps practices to ensure consistent environments and secure deployments. Currently, I work on fullstack platform development using the Laravel ecosystem, applying modern PHP, MySQL, and SQL Server in large-scale solutions for companies in the financial and credit recovery sectors.
